LESSON: INTERPERSONAL ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.4: Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT
